standard_prerequisites.name: The evaluate map is an isomorphism for pseudo-coherent truncated objects by the previous technical lemma
Finite tor dimension of RHom(L, M) and finite injective dimension of L, M bound the cohomology of both sides on the upper truncations

core_obligations: Fix n and use the canonical truncation triangle of K, whose existence is recorded in the derived categories remark (proof lines 28634-28639).

On tau_{>= n+1} K: by assumption (3) and the evaluate-isomorphism lemma the map is an isomorphism for tau_{<= n} K; it remains to show both sides applied to tau_{>= n+1} K have no cohomology in degrees <= n - c for some c (proof lines 28640-28648).

The vanishing follows immediately from assumptions (2) and (1): finite tor dimension bounds the tensor side and finite injective dimension bounds the RHom side; conclude the map is an isomorphism (proof lines 28648-28649).
proof_roadmap: Set up the truncation triangle (proof lines 28634-28639).
Prove the isomorphism on the lower truncations and reduce to a vanishing statement (proof lines 28640-28648).
Conclude by the boundedness from assumptions (1) and (2) (proof lines 28648-28649).
